ego_planning_profile.lateral_search: first map wall on either side; no fixed offset cap
ego_planning_profile.search_trigger: unsafe or low executable speed; preserve progressing paths
ego_planning_profile.planning_optimization: batched map corridor, unique LiDAR arcs, exact map cache, batched opponent hypotheses

ego_planning_profile.depleted_gap_escape: positive initial separation must not decrease and must restore 0.08m by horizon

result.perception: ego LiDAR residual clustering and temporal tracking; own simulator localization
